title: Tie a necktie on a collar form
instruction: Tie a simple (Oriental) necktie knot on the collar form and leave it ready to wear.
context: Preparing a wearable tie requires managing a broad fabric strip, keeping its face outward and adjusting a knot to a collar and usable length.
setup: An adult 1.45 m fabric necktie with pointed ends, 70 mm wide end and 35 mm narrow end, nominal effective thickness 1.2 mm and mass 37.55 g. Pale and gold opposite-edge markings identify its front face: pale left and gold right with the wide tip down. A rigid 110 mm-diameter, 100 mm-high neck form is centred at (0.400, 0, 1.250) m. A 162 mm-diameter, 5 mm-thick lower collar rim is centred at (0.400, 0, 1.2225) m. Fifteen rigid collar-flap pieces, each 3x 15x 60 mm, stand at z=1.250 m on a 79 mm-radius arc around the neck: angles−70° to+70° in 10° steps from+x, 3 mm dimension radial and 15 mm tangent. The front is open. A 210x 25x 25 mm rear arm is centred at (0.495, 0, 1.190) m; a 25x 25x 455 mm rear post at (0.590, 0, 0.975) m; and a 180x 160x 12 mm base at (0.590, 0, 0.7535) m on the YAM table at z=0.7475 m. A 3 mm dark centre mark is at (0.3449, 0, 1.250) m. Start with the tie inside-out, untied and uncrossed around the collar, both ends accessible in front and the wide tip resting on the table. The shared five-second gravity settling uses the recorded untied reset shape, without any attachment. Length is measured downward from the neck form’s lower edge at z=1.200 m.
scoring: Draft: 0.5 for a verified simple (Oriental) knot remaining after both hands release for 5 seconds. Award 1.0 if also centred within 15 mm of the collar mark, maximum neckband gap 10 mm, wide face outward without a half-twist, narrow end behind it with its tip at least 10 mm above the wide tip, and wide tip 400–440 mm below the collar’s lower edge. Otherwise 0. Damaged cloth, material passing through itself or a solid support, hidden attachments or artificial tightening invalidate the run. Fit bands remain provisional until a complete physical knot is demonstrated; see JUDGING.md.
run_limit: Proposed: 3,600 control steps, 3 minutes at 20 Hz, including the final 5-second released hold.
reset_notes: Restore the same untied inside-out collar drape, without a crossing or preformed loop. The shared simulation reset loads the recorded naturally settled untied shape against its unchanged flat rest mesh, then advances exactly 100 ordinary ready-position control steps (5 seconds at 20 Hz). Every policy uses this layout and physics. Adult reset and a physical 318.7 mm pickup are demonstrated; a completed knot is not.
fidelity: Native triangular surface FEM models strip width, bending, stretch and self-contact. A single effective shell approximates the sewn/interlined tie; the collar and stand are rigid. The scripted feasibility controller may read measured material geometry to choose ordinary robot joint targets; Dream receives only its normal camera/joint observations. No rope substitute, object repositioning, attachment or animated tightening is used. Material response is approximate and functional knot retention remains unvalidated.
scores: Not evaluated. No demo or Dream score exists.
